description: Read and write access to source code, development tools, and libraries is not appropriately managed.
applicability: Applies to organizations that develop software and do not properly control access to source code repositories, development tools, software libraries, and build environments through appropriate access controls and segregation.

metadata.detection_notes: Review source code repository access controls, version control system permissions, development tool access, library management, branch protection rules, code review requirements, and segregation between development and production environments.
